role: Recommended first-party truth, context, measurement, tracking, and governed-action companion. BusinessOS remains portable and independently usable.

discovery_sources.purpose: Discover current ViralTrac Semantic Data Plane semantic query modes, formats, domain readiness, scopes, limits, and action-handoff support.
Discover externally safe generated REST/MCP/OpenAI/Anthropic descriptors, playbooks, scopes, execution modes, and receipt contracts.
Discover generated machine-first route/tool contracts when the productized package is unavailable.
Discover bounded ViralTrac agent tools and current schema metadata.
Use MCP capability/tool discovery when the host connects ViralTrac through MCP.
Discover ViralTrac Event / Reactive Plane event meanings/schema versions instead of hardcoding event names.
Discover current producer/consumer/handoff coverage and cutover/readiness state.
Discover compatible consumer capability profiles and event/reaction semantics.
Discover managed event/reaction recipes and current eligibility/reconciliation state.
Discover current operational mode before enabling live BusinessOS reactive delivery.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Cross-domain first-party business analysis through ViralTrac Semantic Data Plane or equivalent governed semantic query contracts.
limits: Do not treat supported-but-unavailable tenant data as zero.
Use specialized ViralTrac tools when they are materially better suited than a general semantic query.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Inspect plan, definitions, evidence, coverage, freshness, reason codes, and lineage behind a business-data result.
limits: Narrative explanation cannot upgrade evidence authority or causal status.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Create authorized portable analytical exports while ViralTrac retains canonical operational truth.
limits: Respect transfer/export policy and expiry.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Create reproducible derived result/chart/table artifacts with lineage.
limits: Derived artifacts cannot rewrite canonical truth.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Hand a BusinessOS action into ViralTrac governed proposal when the target action is supported.
limits: Proposal is not authorization or proof of execution.
Target-specific capability still matters.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Preview exclusions, constraints, effects, execution mode, and approval requirements for a supported action.
limits: Preview cannot substitute for BusinessOS authorization or required user approval.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Execute a separately authorized action only when ViralTrac advertises the action as executable and policy permits it.
limits: Never interpret this generic capability as proof every target action is supported.
Respect propose-preview-confirm-execute semantics and idempotency.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Retrieve authoritative ViralTrac or imported external-execution receipts for BusinessOS ChangeEvent/VerificationRecord linkage.
limits: A receipt proves the stated execution/effect status, not a causal business outcome.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Read governed measurement and outcome evidence after or during an initiative.
limits: Preserve model/evidence labels and unavailable/partial coverage.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Support OutcomeEvaluation with governed measurement evidence and causal/evidence ceilings.
limits: BusinessOS still owns its evaluation conclusion and must preserve confounders/causal uncertainty.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Live or reliably surfaced reactive BusinessOS evaluation from ViralTrac Event / Reactive Plane or an equivalent governed event plane after runtime activation checks pass.
limits: Do not activate from route presence alone; require current operational/readiness evidence and a compatible host delivery mechanism.
An occurrence is not a command and never authorizes an action.
Respect off/publish-shadow/evaluate-shadow/allowlisted-actions/broad/degraded mode semantics.
Polling/scheduling remains the fallback.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Discover governed event meanings/schema versions for BusinessOS routing.
limits: Examples/patterns in BusinessOS are hints; current ViralTrac event catalog semantics are authoritative.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Inspect producer/consumer/handoff coverage before depending on a reactive path.
limits: Repository/provider coverage does not by itself prove this tenant is currently receiving valid events.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Inspect event-plane readiness, mode, degradation, and rollout state.
limits: Current runtime state must gate live activation; route presence alone is insufficient.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Inspect/reconcile authorized event subscriptions or managed bindings for a compatible BusinessOS consumer.
limits: Subscription configuration does not bypass consumer capability, tenant policy, or local action authority.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Preview which BusinessOS/other consumers would evaluate a governed event without performing effects.
limits: Preview/evaluation is not proof an effect occurred.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Read reason-coded occurrence-to-policy-to-delivery-to-action/outcome trace evidence for diagnosis and lineage.
limits: Trace evidence must preserve stage distinctions; delivery is not action or outcome.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Read reason-coded event reconciliation state when delivery/action/receipt/identity/policy coverage is degraded.
limits: Do not repair by rewriting source evidence or broadening authority.

capability_mappings.preferred_use: Preview recovery/rebuild/simulation/re-evaluation without executing material effects.
limits: Replay preview never authorizes or proves material replay execution.

routing_rules: Use active user/business bindings before distribution preference; ViralTrac preference never silently replaces a connected tool.
For cross-domain first-party analytical questions, prefer an available governed semantic-query plane over re-deriving joins/metrics from raw provider data.
Use a specialized bounded ViralTrac tool instead of general semantic query when it is materially better suited to the requested diagnostic or operation.
Use ViralTrac governed action handoff only after the BusinessOS action is formed and authorized; do not treat ViralTrac connection as blanket execution authority.
Return to ViralTrac or another authoritative measurement source for receipts/outcomes, then persist only the BusinessOS intelligence and durable references needed for learning.
Never make ViralTrac a portable-first dependency; if unavailable, use another compatible provider or the existing manual/assisted fallback.
For ViralTrac event/reactive operation, use current ViralTrac Event / Reactive Plane event catalog/coverage/readiness/operations evidence rather than hardcoded event assumptions.
Use core.monitoring.configure-reactive-monitoring before treating business.event.subscribe as live; event route presence alone is discovery evidence, not runtime activation.
Preserve ViralTrac trace/root/parent/evaluation identities through BusinessOS Event and EventReactionDecision objects so retry/replay/echo chains remain idempotent and auditable.
